geometry.coordinates: Points. XY helpers take active-artboard-relative x right/y down; DOM bounds and getContext use document x right/y up. Millimeter conversions are explicit.
geometry.notes: Requires an open document for DOM helpers. Creation helpers mutate artwork. Optional ownership scopes must be completed or cleaned by the caller; inspect cleanup failures. Signatures list formal arguments; notes specify optional values.

example.prerequisites: An open document with an active artboard.
example.code: var p = pointXY(10, 20); return {point: p, context: getContext(), tenMm: mmToPoints(10)};

getContext.returns: {left, top, right, bottom, width, height, centerX, centerY} for the active artboard.

pointXY.returns: {left, top}: document coordinates converted from artboard-relative points.

rectXY.signature: rectXY(x, y, w, h, options, scope)
rectXY.notes: Top-left XY, width/height in points; optional options.cornerRadius in points; optional ownership scope.

ellipseXY.notes: Top-left XY and dimensions in points; optional ownership scope.

lineXY.notes: Endpoints in artboard XY points; optional ownership scope.

polygonXY.notes: points is an array of [x,y] pairs; closed defaults true; scope optional.

getVisibleBounds.notes: For clipped groups uses the clipping path geometric bounds when found; otherwise item.visibleBounds.

_createPath.returns: Boolean: whether Bezier handles were supplied.
_createPath.notes: Internal helper modifies an existing PathItem. Points are [x,y], {anchor,left,right}, or [anchor,inHandle,outHandle]; artboard XY converts using explicit abLeft/abTop.

drawPathPoints.notes: Supply points or subpaths, never both; each path needs at least two points. closed defaults true. compound requires closed subpaths. Optional appearance, target.layer, meta and id; id must be unique. Coordinates are artboard XY points.

layout.coordinates: Document visible bounds use points, Y up. arrangeInGrid spacing and batchResize dimensions use millimeters. createGrid and distribute gaps use points.
layout.notes: Mutates supplied PageItems or creates artwork. Requires an open document and editable items. Returned DOM items are not JSON-serializable.

example.prerequisites: An open document; select at least two editable items.
example.code: var items = []; for (var i = 0; i < app.activeDocument.selection.length; i++) items.push(app.activeDocument.selection[i]); if (items.length < 2) throw new Error('Select at least two items'); distributeHorizontal(items, 10); return {arranged: items.length, gapPoints: 10};

arrangeInGrid.notes: PageItem array, positive integer columns, spacing in millimeters. Anchors at first item's visible top-left; rows use their maximum height.

batchResize.notes: Truthy dimensions in millimeters; omit one for proportional resizing, supply both for independent width/height. Uses visible dimensions.

createGrid.returns: Array of created PathItems in row-major order.
createGrid.notes: Required rows, cols, itemWidth, itemHeight. Dimensions/gapX/gapY/cornerRadius/offsetX/offsetY in points. gapX defaults 10, gapY to gapX. shape rect or ellipse; optional colors and names arrays. Centered on active artboard; offsets x right/y down.

distributeHorizontal.notes: At least two items for an effect. gap optional in points; omission distributes within existing outer span.

distributeVertical.notes: At least two items for an effect. gap optional in points; omission distributes within existing outer span.

alignCenter.notes: Centers aggregate visible bounds on active artboard, preserving relative placement; empty array is a no-op.

alignHorizontal.notes: At least two items. left/right align outer edges; other values (including omitted) align to mean item center X.

alignVertical.notes: At least two items. top/bottom align outer edges; other values (including omitted) align to mean item center Y.

selection.coordinates: Document points, Y up; spatial sort uses a five-point tolerance.
selection.notes: Reads active document selection. Does not change selection.

example.prerequisites: An open document.

getOrderedSelection.returns: Array of selected items, or [] when empty.
getOrderedSelection.notes: column-major sorts X first; other orders use rows top to bottom. reverse is optional.

assets.coordinates: Document points, X right/Y up; bounds are [left,top,right,bottom].
assets.notes: Reads placed and raster items; does not mutate artwork.

example.prerequisites: An open document; an empty asset list is valid.

analyzeAssets.notes: scope is selection, document, or a layer name; assets sorted by name.

getAssetInfo.notes: PlacedItem/RasterItem: name,type,bounds,width,height,aspectRatio,orientation,position,isLinked,filePath. Missing link path is null.

collectAllPlaced.returns: Array of placed items followed by raster items.

collectPlacedFromLayer.returns: Array of placed/raster items, including sublayers.

isPlacedOrRaster.notes: Checks typename for PlacedItem or RasterItem.

geo_ir.coordinates: Pure numeric geometry preserves the supplied coordinate frame and units; use artboard XY points when passing results to XY creation helpers.
geo_ir.notes: IR constructors do not draw. Constructors are permissive; call irValidate before consuming external IR.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

irPath.notes: points is [[x,y],...]; closed defaults false; meta optional object.

irBezierPath.returns: Bezier path IR with absolute handles.
irBezierPath.notes: handles parallels points, with in/out pairs and optional type. Missing type is filled in on the supplied handle objects; closed defaults false.

irMulti.notes: paths array and metadata default empty.

irPoints.notes: points array and metadata default empty.

isIR.notes: Duck check for a string ir property, not full validation.

irValidate.notes: Validates IR version, type, points and handle structure; constructors alone do not ensure validity.

irFlatten.notes: A path becomes [obj], multi returns its paths, other types return []; not recursive flattening.

irPointCount.returns: Number of points across the IR.

irMapPoints.returns: Transformed IR, or unchanged input for unrecognized/non-IR values.
irMapPoints.notes: fn takes a coordinate pair and returns a pair; maps anchors and absolute handles; metadata remains shared.

curves.coordinates: Pure numeric geometry preserves the supplied coordinate frame and units; use artboard XY points when passing results to XY creation helpers.
curves.notes: Curve construction returns IR without DOM writes. Angles are radians.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

smoothCurve.notes: pts is [[x,y],...]; tension defaults 0.5; closed false. Two or fewer points produce a polyline.

naturalSpline.notes: closed defaults false; two or fewer points produce a polyline.

circularArc.signature: circularArc(cx, cy, r, startAngle, endAngle, segments)
circularArc.notes: Center/radius in input units; radians; segments optional, defaults to at most 90 degrees per segment.

ellipticalArc.signature: ellipticalArc(cx, cy, rx, ry, startAngle, endAngle, segments)
ellipticalArc.notes: Radii in input units; radians; optional segment count. Zero angular span produces a point path.

roundedPolygon.notes: verts are coordinate pairs; closed defaults true; radius limited by adjacent edge lengths.

grid_helper.coordinates: artboardGrid cells use artboard-relative points, X right/Y down. itemsInCell records use document bounds and centers, Y up.
grid_helper.notes: Reads artwork. Cell labels are row letters and 1-based columns, e.g. A1.

example.prerequisites: An open document with an active artboard.

artboardGrid.notes: Defaults 4 by 4. Supply integer cols 1..99, rows 1..26 and a nonempty active artboard. Each cell has x,y,width,height.

itemsInCell.notes: opts.mode is containsCenter (default) or intersects. Reports visible non-guide artwork with document bounds; no handles are issued.

session.notes: Host-engine stash, namespaced by document name (or __no_doc__). Not durable storage or object identity. Do not mutate references returned by stashGet.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

stashPut.notes: Stores a direct data reference; use JSON-serializable data. Optional metadata object.

stashGet.notes: Returns the stored reference, not a clone.

stashPutIR.notes: Validates with irValidate before storing; optional metadata.

stashKeys.returns: Array of keys in the current document namespace.

stashClear.notes: Truthy key deletes one entry; omitted key clears the current namespace.

stashInfo.notes: Entries include key,ns,ts,size,meta; size is serialized string length.

validate.coordinates: Document points, X right/Y up; bounds are [left,top,right,bottom].
validate.notes: Read-only geometric checks; result serialization differs between helpers.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

isItemCenterOnArtboard.notes: Both arguments are document [left,top,right,bottom]; center containment includes edges.

isLayerHidden.notes: Checks invisible ancestor layers; unreadable ancestry returns false.

countItemsOnArtboard.returns: JSON string containing counts and a sample of off-artboard items.
countItemsOnArtboard.notes: Optional artboardIndex (default active), boundsType visible/geometric, boundsSource group_visible/clipping_path, policy fully-contained/intersects, scope document/artboard, ignoreHidden and ignoreLocked (both default true). Requires an open document; parse the returned string before combining with other JSON data.

publicationPreflightScan.returns: Bounded publication checks, measurements, issues, scope, summary and coverage.
publicationPreflightScan.notes: options: publication thresholds, artboard_index, scan_max_items, scan_budget_ms. Missing font/raster evidence is unknown. Cooperative budgets are not host timeouts.

item_ref.notes: Locator and tag helpers. Reading descriptions does not stamp notes; assign helpers do. Locators are not stable handles.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

getIndexPath.returns: Array of indices along the item container path.

describeItem.notes: Deprecated: use describeItemV2. Optional fallback layer; item.layer takes precedence when readable.

describeItemV2.notes: options.includeIdentity and includeTags default enabled unless false; tags is {tags: map}. No ID assignment.

assignItemId.notes: Deprecated: use assignItemIdV2. Attempts to replace note ID; write failure is swallowed, so returned ID does not prove stamping succeeded.

assignItemIdV2.notes: policy defaults none; preserve reads existing ID, opt_in keeps an existing ID or assigns, always replaces. Writes item.note when assigning.

mcp_id.notes: Token-aware note identity utilities. Reading never stamps; setMcpId writes. Walk helpers traverse document layers to avoid stale document-level collections.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

extractMcpId.returns: First MCP ID string or null.

extractAllMcpIds.returns: Array of ID tokens in note order.

noteHasMcpId.notes: Exact complete token match, not substring matching.

findItemsByMcpId.notes: opts.limit is optional maximum scanned items; 0 means unlimited. Inspect duplicate and truncated before trusting identity.

setMcpId.notes: Replaces existing ID tokens in item.note while preserving other content.

removeIdFromNote.returns: Note string with ID tokens removed.

mcpWalkPageItems.notes: visitor(item) returns truthy to stop; opts.limit default unlimited.

mcpFindItemByRef.notes: Matches the exact retained DOM reference in a fresh walk, not similar metadata.

error_envelope.notes: Constructs the shared JSX error envelope without throwing.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

makeError.notes: code is an ErrorCodes value; optional localization itemRef and details.

field_eval.coordinates: Spatial field evaluators use the target/document context; numeric outputs retain the destination parameter units.
field_eval.notes: Field descriptors are {$field: name, ...parameters}. Registration changes the evaluator table for this execution.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

FIELD_EVALUATORS.notes: Evaluator name to function table; populated at include time.

registerFieldEvaluator.notes: fn(fieldParams, context) returns a resolved value; registers by name.

isField.notes: Recognizes a $field descriptor, not a full semantic validation.

containsFields.notes: Recursively checks objects and arrays for field descriptors.

evaluateField.notes: evalCtx has target,index,total,doc. Unknown evaluator throws.

resolveFields.returns: New parameter object with descriptors resolved.
resolveFields.notes: Pass current target, zero-based index, total target count and execution context with doc.

snapshot.coordinates: Document points, X right/Y up; bounds are [left,top,right,bottom].
snapshot.notes: Partial property recovery of @mcp:id-tagged items only. Cannot recreate deletions, anchors, text, grouping, z-order or full appearance. Inspect failure/notFound counts; this is not a document transaction.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

captureSnapshot.returns: Snapshot object with version,timestamp,docName,items and layers.
captureSnapshot.notes: options.clock optional. mcpOnly has no effect: untagged items are always excluded. Layer properties are captured but not restored.

restoreSnapshot.notes: geometry and style default true, restoreSize and visibility default false. Best effort; can partially apply before failure.

serializeColor.notes: Supports RGB, CMYK, gray, spot name, and none; unsupported types return null.

deserializeColor.notes: Supports rgb,cmyk,gray,none; spot descriptors are not reconstructed.

SNAPSHOT_RECOVERY_SCOPE.notes: Human-readable limit on snapshot recovery coverage.

checkpoint.coordinates: Document points, X right/Y up; bounds are [left,top,right,bottom].
checkpoint.notes: Named, bounded property snapshots built on snapshot.jsx, not full-document backups. Saved by document key with a filesystem fallback; inspect warnings and partial restore results.

example.prerequisites: An open document; reads the checkpoint store and may load its filesystem fallback.

checkpointSave.notes: Name uses letters, digits, spaces, dot, underscore or hyphen. Limits: 2000 items and 2 MiB serialized data.

checkpointRestore.notes: opts: geometry,style,visibility,restoreSize as in restoreSnapshot. Cannot reconstruct deleted items or structural edits.

checkpointDelete.notes: Removes the named stored checkpoint, not artwork.

targets.coordinates: Document points, X right/Y up; bounds are [left,top,right,bottom]. Spatial selectors can explicitly use artboard coordinates.
targets.notes: Collection helpers return DOM references, never stamp notes. normalizeTargetSelector accepts flat or wrapped selectors and can add a default type to the supplied object; it rejects unknown selector and nested filter fields, with at most 16 compound levels.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

findLayer.notes: Looks up a layer by name.

collectContainerItems.notes: Container has pageItems; recursive controls group descent.

queryItems.notes: query has layer,itemType,pattern,recursive; pattern is a regular expression string.

collectTargets.notes: Supports selection,all,layer,query,id,spatial,grid,compound,handle. Optional opts.report collects unresolvedIds, opts.startingSelection stabilizes batch selection. Collection applies ordering, exclusions and maxScan, including grid selectors; compound also applies internal exclusion.

normalizeTargetSelector.notes: Omitted selector defaults selection; maxScan must be a positive integer when supplied. Supports flat selector or {target,...} wrapper. Does not resolve artwork.

dedupeTargetItems.returns: New array with duplicate references removed.

handles.coordinates: Document points, X right/Y up; bounds are [left,top,right,bottom].
handles.notes: Ephemeral host-engine handles do not write artwork notes or names. Five-minute retention, maximum 500 records; resolution refreshes expiry and requires the exact live object in the bound active document.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

mcpIssueHandle.notes: PageItem and optional document-session token; omitted token binds the active document. Success record includes handle,documentToken,sessionEpoch,issuedAt,expiresAt,itemType,itemName,bounds,status.

mcpIssueHandles.returns: Array of issue results, one per item.
mcpIssueHandles.notes: Same optional token as mcpIssueHandle; inspect each ok value.

mcpResolveHandle.notes: Current limitation: supply the explicit, bound active Document as doc. Omitted/null doc is broken in the shipped bundle: validation returns no document reference, so resolution reports stale and invalidates an otherwise live handle. A subsequent attempt reports unknown, even with doc supplied. Unknown/expired/stale handles fail; no metadata-based substitution.

mcpHandleStatus.notes: Current limitation: calls mcpResolveHandle with null doc, so an otherwise live handle reports stale and is invalidated (subsequent resolution reports unknown). Do not use as a harmless status probe. Until repaired, use mcpResolveHandle(handle, explicitBoundActiveDocument) and inspect its result.

mcpHandleInvalidateAll.notes: Clears all retained handles and changes epoch; optional reason defaults reset.

doc_session.coordinates: Document points, X right/Y up; bounds are [left,top,right,bottom].
doc_session.notes: Document sessions retain exact DOM document references in the host engine. Tokens are not paths and do not survive engine reset; validate before mutation.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

mcpDocBind.notes: Binds active document; optional opts.label. Rebinding reuses the token. No-document binding is a successful app-level state with no token or binding, not a failure. Check token/status before document-bound work.

mcpDocValidate.returns: Success: {ok:true,status,token,boundName,currentName,renamed,isActive,context}; failure: {ok:false,status,message,...}. No document object is returned.
mcpDocValidate.notes: opts.requireActive defaults true; token must refer to the retained live document. Success status is valid or valid_inactive (when requireActive is false). Retained DOM references remain internal; validation.document is undefined.

mcpDocContext.notes: With a token, validates using requireActive:false and returns its context. Without a token, reads active-document context with ok:true,status:'unbound' and creates no binding. Without an active document returns ok:false,status:'no_document'. Context includes active artboard and coordinate data.

mcpDocRelease.notes: Removes the retained binding, not the document.

mcpDocSessions.notes: Lists live bindings after pruning closed documents.

mcpDocList.returns: Live documents and active document with reference tokens, without activation.

mcpDocActivate.returns: Explicitly activate a live document; invalid tokens fail.

observation.coordinates: clipBox is [left,top,right,bottom] in active-artboard-relative points, Y down; returned artboard/item bounds are document points, Y up.
observation.notes: Internal infrastructure. Prefer public tools for normal agent work; direct calls require the surrounding lifecycle described here. Pair begin/end with the same unique observation ID. These retain comparison guards and issue handles without modifying artwork; completeness is bounded by maxItems.

example.prerequisites: An open document; do not reuse an ID belonging to an in-flight observation.
example.code: var before = mcpObservationBegin('reference-example', 10); return {before: before, preservation: mcpObservationEnd('reference-example')};

mcpObservationBegin.signature: mcpObservationBegin(observationId, maxItems, clipBox, exactVisibleCount, clipSpace, includeMap)
mcpObservationBegin.notes: maxItems defaults 200; clipBox optional. exactVisibleCount opts into a full visible-total scan; otherwise totals may be lower bounds (totalVisibleExact=false). Requires active document; abandoned guards are bounded to 32 records and ten minutes, pruned only at a new managed begin. Eviction never reconciles host work.

mcpObservationEnd.notes: Consumes the guard and compares document, artboard, selection and recorded artwork properties. Missing guard reports unavailable; not a full document diff.

host_runtime.notes: Internal infrastructure. Prefer public tools for normal agent work; direct calls require the surrounding lifecycle described here. Persistent host job bookkeeping, not an agent execution API. Reset/init can invalidate sessions or displace jobs; do not call them inside normal drawing scripts.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

mcpRuntimeState.returns: Runtime state object, including present and version/session/job metadata.
mcpRuntimeState.notes: Does not initialize an absent runtime.

mcpRuntimeBeginWork.returns: Begin result with ok,status/sessionEpoch/activeJobs as applicable.
mcpRuntimeBeginWork.notes: spec is jobId string or {jobId,digest,context}; requires initialized runtime and a valid job ID. Internal managed phase requests also supply phase and context.owner; continuation requires the same owner/digest and the exact next phase. Missing history refuses continuation.

mcpRuntimeCompleteWork.notes: Finalizes active job. outcome.status: succeeded,failed,partial (other becomes unknown); optional effects,errors,result,context. Only this route records completed:true for a whole-job finalizer. Internal outcome.phase finalizers instead retain completed:false/status:unknown and context.lastPhase evidence, because later logical-job steps are not established.

mcpRuntimeJobStatus.notes: Reads retained outcome without replay. Missing records remain unknown.

mcpRuntimeEndWork.notes: Ends bookkeeping; does not establish a completed outcome. Prefer managed CompleteWork.

mcpRuntimeReset.notes: Clears runtime state; managed lifecycle only.

heap.notes: Internal infrastructure. Prefer public tools for normal agent work; direct calls require the surrounding lifecycle described here. Heap transactions track the identity index, not DOM rollback. Registering/deleting index entries does not create/remove artwork. stampMcpId writes notes.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

heapBeginTxn.notes: Starts an identity-index transaction; optional document defaults active. Managed batches own this lifecycle.

heapRegister.notes: Associates an MCP ID with a PageItem reference.

stampMcpId.notes: Replaces the entire item.note with the MCP ID token and registers the item in the heap.

resolveIdCompat.notes: Legacy first-match ID resolution; opts.freshScan bypasses heap and scans doc.pageItems, then caches a match. Does not detect duplicate IDs.

heapTombstone.notes: Marks an ID deleted in the current transaction/index.

heapDelete.notes: Records index deletion with reference for rollback; does not remove the item.

heapResolve.notes: Checks tombstones/index and falls back to document lookup.

heapResolveMany.notes: Preserves requested order and skips missing IDs.

heapRebuildIndex.notes: Rebuilds the identity cache from the document.

ownership.notes: Internal infrastructure. Prefer public tools for normal agent work; direct calls require the surrounding lifecycle described here. This library has no required executor dependency; local sequence IDs and optional recovery hooks are self-contained. Scopes own newly allocated DOM objects until transfer/release. Register immediately after allocation. Cleanup can fail: always propagate failed records. Never use a cleanup scope to claim ownership of preexisting artwork.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

mcpOwnBegin.notes: Optional diagnostic label; nested scopes retain a parent.

mcpOwnAllocate.notes: Registers immediately after creation; optional diagnostic kind.

mcpOwnIdentify.notes: Records an already-stamped ID; does not stamp it.

mcpOwnAbsorb.notes: consumed is an array of owned items now inside the already-registered container; suppresses separate child cleanup.

mcpOwnReplace.notes: Registers a newly returned container and absorbs consumed items; optional kind.

mcpOwnCommit.notes: Transfers ownership to an open parent; root commit retains artwork. released entries are MCP IDs when known, otherwise allocation IDs.

mcpOwnRelease.notes: Ends ownership permanently without transfer to the parent; retains artwork.

mcpOwnCleanup.notes: Removes owned artwork; retries failed removals on subsequent calls. Failed entries carry allocId,mcpId,error.

mcpOwnDispose.notes: Removes one owned item and records the outcome.

mcpOwnRecords.notes: No live DOM references in the public records.

mcpOwnAllRecords.returns: Array of public records across retained scopes.

mcpOwnReset.notes: Test seam: clears scope/recovery bookkeeping; does not remove artwork. Not called by production paths.

ops_core.coordinates: Operation parameters generally use artboard XY points; inspect illustrator://ops/{name} for operation-specific units. Runtime identity/recovery helpers have no coordinates.
ops_core.notes: Internal infrastructure. Prefer public tools for normal agent work; direct calls require the surrounding lifecycle described here. Includes the batch executor, not every handler. Include required ops_* modules for dispatch. Discovery membership never registers a handler.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

OP_HANDLERS.notes: Registered operation name to handler table.

registerOpHandler.notes: handler(params, targets, ctx) returns a handler result; changes dispatch table.

validateOp.notes: op has task,targets?,params?,comment?; strict rejects unknown operation keys. This is not full handler validation.

resolveTargets.notes: Uses batch context, selectors and identity facilities; may throw structured resolution errors.

executeOpBatch.returns: Batch report with ok,ops,stats,createdIds and optional diagnostics.
executeOpBatch.notes: ops is an array. Optional options: strict/stopOnError,rollback,snapshot,chunkSize,onProgress,trace,summaryOnly,journal,clock,space,defaultLayer. Uses active document and creates its own execution context. Recovery is partial; inspect returned outcomes.

profileOp.notes: fn() is invoked once; optional clock returns milliseconds.

mcpRecoveryReset.notes: Clears execution-local recovery events and counters.

mcpRecoveryRecord.notes: Adds chronology/identity and records the event; non-object values pass through.

mcpRecoveryMark.notes: Use before an operation as a cursor.

mcpRecoveriesSince.returns: Array of recovery events since cursor.

mcpMergeRecovery.returns: null, one recovery object, or array.
mcpMergeRecovery.notes: Accepts objects or arrays; assigns missing event identity and deduplicates promoted records.

mcpSetCleanupFailures.notes: Writes array into success data or error.details; non-array failures becomes [].

mcpTargetIdentity.returns: MCP ID, ephemeral handle, or null.
mcpTargetIdentity.notes: Reads note first, then may issue a handle. Does not stamp notes.

presets.coordinates: Document points, X right/Y up; bounds are [left,top,right,bottom]. Preset margins/gutters and slot sizes are points. fitToSlot reports scale as a multiplier (1 preserves size).
presets.notes: Layout helpers mutate items. Palette lookup helpers return definitions or DOM colors. Do not mutate shared preset/palette tables.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

getPreset.notes: Unknown name throws; discover names with listPresets.

computeSlotGeometry.notes: artboardRect is document [left,top,right,bottom]; slots have index,row,col,x,y,width,height with y the top edge.

fitToSlot.notes: slot has document x,y,width,height. mode defaults contain; cover may extend beyond slot. Zero-dimension item returns error. Returned scale is a multiplier; resize internally receives percent.

applyPreset.notes: Arranges up to slot capacity on active artboard. mode defaults contain, or cover; extra items are untouched. Does not propagate per-item fitToSlot error results.

COLOR_PALETTES.notes: Named palette definitions and color arrays.

getColor.notes: Supply nonnegative integer index; wraps by palette length; unknown palette throws.

getColorDef.notes: Supply nonnegative integer index; wraps by palette length; returned definition is shared.

getPaletteInfo.notes: Unknown palette throws; colors is the shared array of color definitions.

applyPaletteToItems.notes: options.fill defaults true, stroke false. Cycles palette over PageItems; failures may be skipped.

task_pipeline.notes: Internal infrastructure. Prefer public tools for normal agent work; direct calls require the surrounding lifecycle described here. Generic collect/compute/apply pipeline. Use the public task tools to supply the protocol envelope and execution lifecycle.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

safeExecute.returns: fn(item) result, or null on caught error.
safeExecute.notes: Appends an error to report; stage identifies collect/compute/apply etc.

buildReport.notes: Caller supplies status, counters, timing and diagnostic arrays.

validatePayload.notes: Validates TaskPayload {task,version,targets,params,options}; does not run it.

executeTask.notes: Callbacks: collectFn(doc,targets), computeFn(items,params,report), applyFn(actions,report). Requires active document and valid payload.

executeTaskWithRetry.notes: Deprecated wrapper; clones payload and sets retry stages collect/compute, maxAttempts to maxRetries or 3. Prefer executeTaskWithRetrySafe.

executeTaskWithRetrySafe.notes: Retry configuration is payload.options.retry; applies retry stage/code policy rather than blindly repeating mutation.

isRetryable.notes: Tests retryable code and allowed stage; default allowed stages is collect.

recordTaskHistory.notes: Appends an in-session record (maximum 50); needs report.stats and report.timing.

profile.notes: Calls fn() once; propagates thrown errors.

contracts.notes: Generated from the Python operation contract SSOT. Broad validation is not a replacement for nested typed models or handler checks. Never edit the generated JSX to change schemas.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

CONTRACTS_CHECKSUM.notes: Checksum of the generated contract source.

ErrorCodes.notes: Symbolic error names mapped to wire code strings.

validateOpParams.notes: Validates JSX operation availability, broad types, required fields, enums and unknown keys, including audited empty catalogues. Optional null values are treated as absent; false can disable object parameters. Field descriptors defer value checks to runtime. Numeric values must be finite. Python uses the same SSOT and adds near-miss suggestions.

listSchemaOps.notes: Names are contract membership, not proof of registered handlers.

getValueType.notes: Distinguishes null,array and JavaScript typeof values.

ops_journal.notes: Internal infrastructure. Prefer public tools for normal agent work; direct calls require the surrounding lifecycle described here. Legacy JSX journal storage/replay helpers. Filesystem operations can fail. Replay executes operations and is not a dry run or full recovery guarantee.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

journalAppend.notes: entry: batchId,timestamp,ops,options,report. Appends to host memory and rewrites a JSON-array file fallback; file errors are swallowed, leaving memory-only history.

journalGet.notes: Optional doc participates in file location; missing/unreadable data may produce an empty list.

journalClear.notes: Removes stored journal file; optional doc participates in file location.

journalSummary.notes: Reads journal for the named document.

journalReplay.notes: Requires needed handlers included. replayOptions: onError strict/skip/rollback, clock, fromBatchId. Can mutate artwork; inspect per-entry failures/recovery.

jsonStringify.notes: Uses JSON.stringify when available, with a legacy fallback.

generative.coordinates: Pure numeric geometry preserves the supplied coordinate frame and units; use artboard XY points when passing results to XY creation helpers. getArtboardBounds and addLabel use document coordinates, Y up, without XY conversion.
generative.notes: Most helpers are pure numeric algorithms; addLabel creates text. Spatial-hash queries only gather candidate buckets; use a distance check for exact neighbors.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.
example.code: var rng = seededRandom(42); var perm = buildPermTable(rng, 256); return {noise: valueNoise2D(0.2, 0.3, perm)};

buildPermTable.notes: rng() returns [0,1); size defaults 256. Use a positive power of two with valueNoise2D.

getArtboardBounds.notes: doc defaults active, index defaults 0 (not active artboard); out-of-range index clamped. x=left,y=top in document coordinates.

addLabel.signature: addLabel(container, x, y, text, opts, scope)
addLabel.notes: container is Layer/GroupItem; x,y are document pointText coordinates. Nonempty text; opts.size defaults 12 points, optional color,font,name. Optional ownership scope. No artboard-relative conversion; absent color is not explicitly set.

smoothstep.notes: Supply t in [0,1] for interpolation; no clamping.

valueNoise2D.returns: Interpolated scalar noise in [0,1] for a valid permutation table.
valueNoise2D.notes: Use buildPermTable with a power-of-two size greater than one.

fbm.notes: opts.perm required; octaves defaults 4, lacunarity 2, gain 0.5 (truthy defaults).

marchingSquares.notes: field(ix,iy) returns scalar grid samples; cellSize optional {dx,dy}, defaults 1x1.

chainSegments.returns: Array of polylines, each an array of pairs.
chainSegments.notes: Endpoint matching tolerance defaults 0.001 in input units.

chaikinSmooth.notes: iterations defaults 2, closed false; optional maxPoints bounds growth.

decimatePoints.notes: Supply positive integer maximum output count.

cleanPolyline.notes: opts.epsilon defaults 0.001, minSegLen 0, snapClose false; removes coincident/short segments.

chainSegmentsIR.notes: tolerance defaults 0.5; optional metadata; combines chaining and IR construction.

spatialHashBuild.notes: points are coordinate pairs; nonpositive/omitted cellSize becomes 1.

spatialHashQuery.notes: Returns every index in neighboring buckets, including points outside radius. Does not perform exact distance filtering.

pairsWithinRadius.returns: Array of [i,j] index pairs with i<j.
pairsWithinRadius.notes: Uses exact squared-distance comparison; hash must be built from the same coordinate-pair array.

clusterByRadius.notes: points are {x,y,...}, hash built from corresponding pairs; optional reducer(cluster), default centroid with first point's extra fields.

buildFieldGrid.notes: fn(x,y) returns [vx,vy]; bounds is {x,y,w,h}; use positive grid dimensions.

integrateField.notes: field is fn(x,y) or object.lookup; start pair; stepLen in domain units, bounds {x,y,w,h} limits trajectory.

buildCurlField.notes: noiseOpts has perm and optional octaves,lacunarity,gain; bounds {x,y,w,h}, frequency fieldScale; gridOpts optionally cols,rows,eps.

symbols.coordinates: Document points, X right/Y up; bounds are [left,top,right,bottom]. Instance scale is a percentage derived from bounding boxes (100 preserves dimensions), not a multiplier or a recovered transform matrix.
symbols.notes: Read-only symbol inspection; does not place, expand, select or remove artwork. Unavailable symbolArt is reported rather than reconstructed.

example.prerequisites: An open document; symbol-free documents return an empty list.

mcpSymbolDescribeItem.notes: Describes one item; TextFrame adds contents; unavailable fields remain null.

mcpSymbolContents.notes: art is symbol.symbolArt; supply positive integer maxItems. Walks groups to depth 8; cap limits reported items, not total counting within that depth.

mcpSymbolDefinitions.notes: Optional includeContents, maxItems (default 50), name filter. definitionCount is document total even when filtered.

mcpSymbolInstances.notes: Optional name filter and maxInstances (default 200). Scale is [percentX,percentY] from bounds or null; rotationKnown false.

geo_boolean.coordinates: Contours use active-artboard-relative points, X right/Y down. Extraction also returns document/artboard context for guarded commit.
geo_boolean.notes: Internal infrastructure. Prefer public tools for normal agent work; direct calls require the surrounding lifecycle described here. Bridge for Python geometry computation. Prefer illustrator_path_boolean. Reconstruction/deletion mutate artwork; a single host eval is not an atomic document transaction.

example.prerequisites: An open document; the empty ID array reads context without creating or deleting artwork.

extractPathGeometry.returns: JSON string with paths,warnings,context,operandHandles or error details.
extractPathGeometry.notes: Array of MCP IDs or selectors, each resolving exactly one supported path/compound path. If any operand is a selector, all operands are captured as exact handles in operandHandles without writing notes. Includes contour data, appearance diagnostics and per-path precondition signatures. Duplicate/overlapping operands are refused. Inspect error and warnings before computation.

reconstructRegions.returns: JSON string with created ids,itemTypes,regionCount and result details, or error.
reconstructRegions.notes: params.regions: [{id?,outer:[[x,y],...],holes:[[[x,y],...],...]}]; contours require finite pairs and sufficient points. Optional layer,name,style,fillRule. Style uses filled,stroked,fillColor,strokeColor,strokeWidth,opacity. Creates PathItems/CompoundPathItems; propagate thrown cleanup failures.

deleteByMcpIds.returns: JSON string with deleted,deletedIds,failedIds,notFoundIds,warnings and ambiguity details.
deleteByMcpIds.notes: Destructive; IDs must resolve unambiguously. Partial deletion is possible.

commitBooleanRegions.returns: JSON string with ids,itemTypes,regionCount,originals,effects,status,atomic:false or phase/error details. Incomplete required deletion returns error:true, errorCode:BOOLEAN_DELETE_INCOMPLETE and phase:delete; status is partial when artwork changed, failed otherwise. Retained originals are success only when deletion was not requested.
commitBooleanRegions.notes: Requires originalIds, preconditions from extraction, matching context, and regions with assigned unique IDs. For selector extraction also pass its exact operandHandles; commit resolves those handles in the explicit document, never reruns selectors. Optional deleteOriginals (only true deletes), style,layer,name,fillRule. Revalidates inputs, creates/verifies replacements, then deletes originals; inspect partial effects and survivingIds for known surviving handles.

ops_compound.notes: Registers compound dispatch on include. Read illustrator://ops/compound for operation constraints. $prev substitution does not itself execute an operation.

resolvePrevTokens.notes: Replaces previous-operation tokens in a sub-operation; prevId may be null, prevAllIds an array. Missing required previous result fails.

ops_style.notes: Registers style handlers at include time; operation semantics are in illustrator://ops/{name}. Color helper is internal.

example.prerequisites: No Illustrator document is needed for this example.

_parseColorParam.notes: key selects fill/stroke. false/null disables; nested RGB object needs at least one channel; flat r/g/b compatibility accepted. Channels clamp 0..255; no color is not itself an error.

auto_tag.notes: No callable exports: this is a load-time IIFE used by execute_script post-execution. Including it immediately attempts to stamp untagged artwork notes. __PARAMS__ supplies mode delta/converge, scope activeLayer/document, cap (default 200), preCount (default 0), cushion (default 2). Truthy defaults mean zero does not disable cap/cushion. The IIFE yields a JSON string {tagged,cap_hit,need,skipped,assigned,errors}; an ordinary include wrapper may discard that value. Use the managed post-execution route to collect it.

example.prerequisites: Internal load-time example only: use an empty disposable active layer/document. Loading the include performs tagging before this body; it is not a passive import.

raw_fail.notes: Throws an ordinary catchable Error. Details/message are bounded; no rollback or source-line mapping.

example.prerequisites: No document needed.
example.code: try { mcpFail("Label failed", {cause:"example"}); } catch (e) { return String(e); }

mcpFail.returns: Never returns normally; throws MCP_FAIL through the ordinary error path.
